emg.receipt_basis: identical host receipt time (v1: one SDK callback)

bursts.definition: new burst after a receipt gap >= 20 ms

imu.receipt_basis: identical host receipt time (v1: one SDK callback)

bursts.definition: new burst after a receipt gap >= 20 ms

spectrum.status: exploratory: notch/peak positions reflect undocumented firmware filters and are not a rate verification

contact.time_basis: v1: host_time (wall clock) mapped to EMG receipt time; rows were written only when the vector changed; freshness uncertain

policy.note: vendor-demo display convention, not a physiological validity threshold; unknown = missing/non-finite/non-positive/sentinel

contact.duration_assumption: each observation's level is held until the next observation in the same segment (or the segment's last EMG receipt), at most 3 s; time beyond that counts as unknown

transients_vs_contact.match: v1: latest observation with receipt time <= transient receipt, same segment (host-receipt-based; freshness uncertain)
transients_vs_contact.caution: association only; a transient is not proven to be an artifact, and green contact does not prove it is muscle activity

markers.emg_sample_index_semantics: last received EMG index when logged

missing_metadata: source: SDK versions, capabilities and parameter readback
task: task / object / trial IDs and demonstration mode
rates: requested / readback / reported / received / verified rates
v1 layout: no callback/block IDs, no per-block diagnostics, no reason codes, contact rows only on change without provenance
clock_limitations: device_time is the SDK nominal timeline (stream-start anchor + sample_index / reported rate), not an independent hardware clock
host_time / host_mono are receipt times of SDK callbacks, delayed and batched by the BLE link, OS and SDK; they are not acquisition times
continuous sample indices do not prove lossless physical acquisition
electrode-skin impedance rows carry host receipt time; the age of the underlying measurement is unknown
